local.rate_basis: declared accounting rate; actual server bill not supplied

strong.documented_model_version: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash as of 2026-09-20; alias is provider-managed, no immutable snapshot promised

operator_scope: text-math configuration; Programmer/Code/Test are supported by executor but require a provisioned sandbox profile

seed_prompts.solve: Solve the supplied task. Follow its output_contract exactly. Return your final answer clearly.
seed_prompts.reason: Work through the task carefully and check the reasoning. Follow the task output_contract exactly.
seed_prompts.review: Review the upstream solution, correct errors and independently verify the result. Follow the task output_contract exactly.
seed_prompts.merge: Compare the independent upstream solutions and verify their claims. Produce a single final answer following the task output_contract.

evaluation.note: Fixed 35-task diagnostic subset: one per 7 subjects x 5 levels, selected by ID hash before observing results; 3 fixed weights x 1 sample; not a full MATH-500 score.

notes: Main method only: no baselines or ablations in this driver.
Changing rounds is the sole short/full-run override once the data/model/evaluation protocol is frozen.
100 formal rounds is a documented engineering placeholder, not an advisor-specified value and not authorization to run.
Local Qwen is the lightweight tier; DeepSeek Flash is the strong tier. No claim that local rental cost is always lower than API cost.
Resource blocks reserve equal worst-case USD-equivalent caps; actual usage and unused caps are separately reported, never claimed to be equal spend.
DeepSeek seed is unsupported and not sent. Non-thinking mode is frozen; temperature is sent and top_p is omitted per provider protocol.
Provider aliases can change; actual response model/fingerprint/usage are recorded. Source-exact reproduction and statistical convergence are not claimed.
Learning: 35 development and 70 calibration tasks stratified across all 7 subjects x 5 difficulties; size is an engineering choice, not full training data.
All inline Asymptote source is retained verbatim as text, not rendered or executed; no evaluation exclusions.
Learning and terminal evaluation have separate API/time ceilings; unused allowance is not transferred. Ceilings are not cost/time estimates or guarantees of completion.
